output.reason: A 70-year-old on warfarin with head trauma yesterday now has a bad headache and two episodes of vomiting, which requires immediate emergency CT imaging for possible intracranial bleeding.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now. You hit your head while taking warfarin, and a bad headache with vomiting a day later can mean bleeding inside the head that needs an urgent CT scan. Do not drive yourself — have someone take you, or call 911 if you feel drowsy, confused, weak on one side, or have trouble speaking or another seizure-like episode.
differential: Subdural or other intracranial hemorrhage related to anticoagulation after head trauma
